title: 접속사
objectives: 접속사 뒤 절 구조(S+V)를 확인하는 습관을 기른다

concept.summary: 접속사는 단어·구·절을 논리적으로 연결합니다. and/but/or/so는 등위, because/if/when/although는 종속절을 이끕니다. TEPS에서는 접속사 선택과 절/구 혼동(despite vs although)이 자주 나옵니다.
points: 등위: and, but, or, so, yet
시간: when, while, before, after, until
대조·양보: but, although, even though / despite + 명사(구)

examples.en: I called, but no one answered.
We postponed the launch because the build failed.
Although the budget is tight, we can proceed.

checks.question: 빈칸: "The plan is solid, ___ funding is uncertain."
"___ the server was down, we worked offline."
checks.explanation: 원인 절을 이끌 때는 Because + S+V입니다.

checks.question: 올바른 문장은?
choices: Despite he was tired, he continued.
Because of he was tired, he continued.
checks.explanation: despite 뒤에는 명사(구)/V-ing. despite being tired.

checks.question: "___ you confirm today, we can ship tomorrow."
"Don't submit it ___ you double-check the figures."
접속사 뒤 구조가 올바른 것은?
choices: Although the delay was short, we apologized.
Although of the delay, we apologized.

checks.question: "___ I agree with the goal, I question the timeline."
checks.explanation: While는 시간뿐 아니라 약한 대조(‘~이긴 하나’)에도 씁니다.

checks.question: 어색한 연결은?
choices: She was late because traffic was heavy.
She was late, so she apologized.
She was late although the roads were clear.
She was late despite traffic was heavy.
checks.explanation: despite 뒤에는 절이 바로 오지 않습니다. despite heavy traffic이 맞습니다.
